result: Native GUI automatically captures successive guest frames and observes a console-driven pattern change from blue to green; stopping returns controls to idle with the last complete frame retained.
limitations: Capture latency is unsuitable for a responsive desktop
Pattern changed through the guest console; graphical keyboard and pointer delivery remain unimplemented in the GUI
Visual pattern verification is not a whole-frame byte comparison
No server-side presentation acknowledgment or incremental frame transfer
No disk persistence, Intel guest or release qualification
